Web: maxreload = 8*24 = 192, HUD fraction (reload-48)/(192-48) = 144 ticks of visible travel = 6.000 s at 24.0 fps. Android: maxreload = 5*24 = 120, HUD fraction (reload-24)/(120-24) = 96 ticks = 4.000 s.
